owner_disposition.scope: Documented historical P3B1 comparator difference accepted by the owner. NOT a numerical pass: the comparator, its tolerance and the P3B1 baseline are unchanged and the strict regression stays listed in the status under owner_accepted_regressions. Bound to this exact candidate SHA-256, the pinned baseline P3B1 and these exact values; any other candidate or value leaves the regression unresolved. Does not waive any other gate.
owner_disposition.owner_statement: Owner decision (user, 2026-10-04): accept the pullup_top torso minimum = 0.670 vs P3B1 0.693 as a documented acceptable difference against the historical P3B1 comparator, subject to the existing development and production gates remaining green. Do NOT re-pin P3B1. Rationale: comparator difference 0.023; tolerance 0.020; excess beyond tolerance only 0.003; development gate margin about 0.52; production-target margin about 0.17; no corresponding visible anatomical defect found; weights-only is already about 0.680; P3B1 itself compresses the same edge substantially; P3B1 had 14 development failures and materially worse associated metrics; r95 is materially better in torso maximum, volume behaviour, self-intersections and overall deformation quality; previous attempts to force this comparator value introduced genuine pull-up arm regressions. Record as an explicit owner disposition associated with r95, not as a fabricated numerical pass. Do not perform another experiment merely to eliminate this comparator difference.

owner_accepted_limitations.owner_statement: Owner decision (user, 2026-10-04): accept the remaining rear neck-to-raised-arm / trapezius drape in r95 as a documented temporary model-volume/skinning limitation, not as an unresolved Phase 3A deformation blocker. Rationale: deformation is continuous through the elevation arc; no jumps or instability were found; no self-intersections occur in the assessed drape zone; the feature is anatomically plausible in kind; it is substantially improved relative to P3B1; pull-up/hang views can read as a normal trapezius/lat slope; the excessive cloth-like appearance in rear overhead views is attributable primarily to missing underlying trapezius/lat/shoulder muscular volume plus the accepted scapular motion; Phase 5A/5B explicitly introduces the missing back/scapular/deltoid/clavicular/axillary surface volume; Phase 5 protects Phase 3A deformation support; there is no demonstrated small, low-risk Phase 3A fix; further neck/shoulder-sheet changes would reopen already demonstrated squat/press/pull-up trade-offs. Do not modify the model further merely to remove this drape during Phase 3. Do not re-pin P3B1. Do not relax any development gate. Do not hide the limitation. Preserve the assessment images/evidence so it can be explicitly re-reviewed during Phase 5 after anatomical volume is added. The previously accepted pullup_top torso minimum owner disposition remains in force exactly as recorded and bound to r95.
